notes.title: 11-17-23 Update: Changed Last 2 Achievement Triggers
notes.content: Updated the Mission Complete and Tutorial achievement triggers.

notes.title: Update Note 11-17-23: Changed Achievement Triggers
notes.content: The achievement triggers have been changed because there is a difference between how certain gaming mechanics manifest between different platforms (i.e. Epic versus Steam) and how they are coded (i.e. an overlap event trigger versus manually triggering an event).

notes.title: Achievements are now active
notes.content: The achievement system is now functional. There are currently 6 achievements in addition to the addition of some new features such as crossplay between Epic's platform with the Epic version of the InVincible Iron Ivy: Enter the Pretty, Pretty Princess.

notes.title: Crossplay Feature Available
notes.content:
Hello All!

This new update introduces the crossplay feature between Steam and the Epic Games Store. If you’re playing on Steam and want to play or connect with players/friends on the Epic Games Store (EGS) to match your global achievements, you'll need to have an EGS account. If you don’t accept, you can only play on Steam and the crossplay will not be enabled. Simply press the "x" in the upper right-hand corner to opt-out and continue playing on Steam. If you accept, a web page will open in your browser asking you to log in to (or create) an EGS account.

[url=https://www.pcgamesn.com/steam/epic-games-store-crossplay]Epic Games Store and Steam crossplay is finally available[/url]
